text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR that consolidates SOC2 audit-log language and adds examples for the new audit_schema v2. Need docs + SDK snippet updates before the next release. PTAL when you have a minute.

sanjay: link to the new schema?

maria: https://internal.redwood/audit/schema/v2 (internal). also added a migration note section in the draft PR.

alex: I can update Go + Node snippets. What's the exact retention phrasing we should use?

maria: Compliance asked for: 'Retention is configurable per customer; default retention is 90 days. Exported audit records may be retained longer when required for legal hold.' Use that, but legal will want slightly different wording — tagging @jen.

jen: Quick note: change 'customer' to 'customer account' in one spot to match legal glossary. Also avoid "may" in the second sentence — prefer "may be retained when required by law or legal process." After that I can sign off.

sanjay: I'll add a short migration example showing how to map old event_type -> new audit_event.category and a curl export example. Planning to include both curl and python snippets.

docs-bot: PR #4821 created by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821 :sparkles:

alex: Draft Go snippet for the PR — feel free to copy/paste and tweak:
```go
// query audit events with retention hint
res, err := client.Audit.Query(ctx, AuditQuery{Start: startTime, End: endTime, Retention: "90d"})
if err != nil { return err }
fmt.Println(len(res.Events))
```

alex: Draft Node snippet:
```js
// node audit query with retention
const res = await client.audit.query({ start: isoStart, end: isoEnd, retention: '90d' })
console.log(res.events.length)
```

sanjay: I'll add a short migration table in the docs: old_field -> new_field, sample mapping for seq/kv cache IDs. Also plan to add a redirect from /docs/audit-log to /docs/audit/schema-v2/export to avoid link rot.

maria: Great. One more ask — update the export JSON example to include the new `audit_event.category` and `service.context` fields. Alex, can you sanity-check the sample JSON in the PR?

alex: Yep will do. I'll push a small commit with updated JSON and snippet formatting (inline code fences, and explicit language tags).

jen: Once wording fix is in, I can approve legal phrasing. I'm OOO tomorrow morning but will review tonight.

maria: Thanks everyone. If legal signs off I'll merge after QA review. Tagging @sre for visibility on export format changes. :wave:
